answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 28223 Country: India Title: If there is aetelam without any dream,bad thinking and enjoyment while sleep,is ghusl farz or not? Question: As salamo alaiku wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.If there is aetelam without any dream,bad thinking and enjoyment while sleep,is ghusl farz or not??? Answer ID: 28223 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 50/40/H=1432) If semen is discharged with lust, ghusl shall be fardh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
